description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Paypal' within the 'Goteo\Library' namespace. It handles interactions with PayPal's adaptive payments and express checkout APIs, providing methods to retrieve payment details and manage errors related to PayPal transactions in the Goteo application. The class utilizes external PayPal SDK classes and references configuration settings for API credentials.

classes.name: Paypal
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with PayPal's adaptive payments and express checkout services, including retrieving payment details and managing errors.

methods.description: Returns the list of error messages encountered during Paypal operations.

methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific PayPal transaction or preapproval, handling different types of payments including preapprovals and transactions.

methods.description: Handles retrieval of payment details for express checkout transactions using a token-based request to PayPal.
